title: A tool's image past the bound an end row keeps is left out of its TOOL_CALL_END row, a note in its place, and reaches the model whole
notes: Python: channels/_tool_event_result.py (TOOL_EVENT_IMAGE_MAX_CHARS, 512 KiB of payload characters); roomkit-rs: roomkit-ai tools/row_bound.rs. The image is a data URL of more than 512 KiB of characters: the bound is the reference's, the RFC asks only for one (RK-21.5-019). Its last characters show the model's copy whole; the row holds a text part in the image's place, whose words are the reference's and are not asserted.
